import Mathlib

namespace Problem52

/--
Let $R$ be a ring, \( \mathfrak{m} \) is an ideal in the Jacobson radical of \( R \),
and \( G_{1}, G_{2} \in R[x] \) are polynomials such that $G_1$ is monic.
If $G_i \mod \mathfrak{m}$ gnerate the unit ideal of $R/\mathfrak{m}[x]$,
then \( G_{1}, G_{2} \) together generate the unit ideal of \( R[x] \).
-/
theorem generate_unit_ideal_of_quotient (R : Type) [CommRing R] (m : Ideal R)
    (h_le_jac : m ≤ Ring.jacobson R) (G₁ G₂ : Polynomial R) (h_monic : G₁.Monic)
    (h_gen : Ideal.span {G₁.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m), G₂.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)} = ⊤) :
    Ideal.span {G₁, G₂} = ⊤ := by
  sorry

end Problem52

import Mathlib
open Polynomial
example (R : Type) [CommRing R] (m : Ideal R)
    (h_le_jac : m ≤ Ring.jacobson R) (G₁ G₂ : Polynomial R) (h_monic : G₁.Monic)
    (h_gen : Ideal.span {G₁.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m), G₂.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)} = ⊤) :
    Ideal.span {G₁, G₂} = ⊤ := by
  set I : Ideal R[X] := Ideal.span {G₁, G₂} with hI
  have hle : Ideal.span {G₁} ≤ I := Ideal.span_mono (by simp)
  haveI := h_monic.finite_quotient
  have hfin : Module.Finite R (R[X] ⧸ I) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R hle).toLinearMap
      (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hle)
  have key : ∀ p : R[X], p ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.map C m = ⊤ → True := fun _ _ => trivial
  have htop : I ⊔ Ideal.map C m = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro p _
    have hs : (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)) p ∈
        Ideal.span {G₁.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m), G₂.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)} := by
      rw [h_gen]; trivial
    have : Ideal.span {G₁.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m), G₂.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)}
        = Ideal.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)) I := by
      rw [hI, Ideal.map_span]; simp [Set.image_pair]
    rw [this] at hs
    have hs2 := Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk m))
      (Polynomial.map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective) I
    have : p ∈ Ideal.comap (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)) (Ideal.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)) I) := hs
    rw [hs2] at this
    rw [← Ideal.add_eq_sup]
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (by simpa [Ideal.sup_eq_add] using this)
    · rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hb
      sorry
  sorry
E
